meta_description: Earthtech Electrical is a Bristol-based electrician specialising in domestic and commercial electrical work. NICEIC certified. Emergency callouts available.
hero_subhead: Faulty wiring or a tripped circuit in Bristol? We diagnose and fix electrical faults fast, with emergency appointments available round the clock.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full rewires, we handle domestic and commercial electrical work with speed and precision.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, dead sockets, or tripped circuits fixed the same day. Our engineers carry common parts on the van for instant diagnosis and repair.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Outdated wiring puts your home at risk. We replace ageing circuits with modern, safe installations and test everything to Building Regulations.

services.title: Fusebox & Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Old fusebox? We install modern RCD-protected consumer units that meet current safety standards and reduce fire risk.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing
services.desc: Strange electrical behaviour? We use professional diagnostic equipment to pinpoint faults quickly and avoid guesswork repairs.

services.title: New Circuit Installation
services.desc: Adding a new kitchen, bathroom, or outdoor space? We design and install dedicated circuits to handle extra demand safely.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Work
services.desc: Office rewires, PAT testing, and emergency lighting installations for Bristol businesses. Rapid turnaround, minimal downtime.

about_pullquote: I started Earthtech because I was tired of customers being overcharged for simple fixes.
about_para_1: Earthtech Electrical was founded 18 years ago on a simple idea: honest pricing and fast, reliable work. We've built our reputation by turning up on time, diagnosing faults properly, and charging fair rates. Every electrician on our team is NICEIC certified and fully insured.
about_para_2: Bristol homeowners and businesses trust us because we don't overcomplicate things. We listen, explain what needs doing, and get the job done right the first time. Over 2,400 completed jobs and hundreds of repeat customers speak for themselves.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Earthtech

reviews.text: Came out to fix a dodgy socket that sparked when plugged in. Really quick diagnosis, very reasonable quote, and he was done in 20 minutes. Put my mind at ease knowing it's sorted properly. Cheers.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Called at 11pm on a Saturday because our lights kept flickering. They actually answered and sent someone round within the hour. Turned out to be a loose connection in the fusebox. Professional job and a fair price without the Sunday premium nonsense. Would use again.
reviews.author: Jennifer W.

reviews.text: Had the whole house rewired last summer. Didn't expect it to be so straightforward — they explained everything, tidied up after themselves, and even tested all the circuits properly. Great service. Still recommending them to everyone.
reviews.author: David C.

address_sub: Serving all of Bristol and South Gloucestershire
emergency_banner_text: Electrical emergency in Bristol? We aim to be with you in under 60 minutes. Call now —
footer_description: Earthtech Electrical is a Bristol-based electrician offering emergency repairs, rewires, and commercial work. NICEIC certified, fast response, fair pricing.
